rules: Choose one clear shot purpose: establish a target, reveal a reaction, or resolve the beat.
Keep faces and important props separated in silhouette. Put gaze targets inside the view.
For two characters, establish a shared wide shot before a closer reaction; front-view rig does not support arbitrary perspective.
move_to controls a bounded stylized walk. It does not provide collision avoidance or a contact solver.
Reuse locked colors/rig IDs across shots. Review silent playback for the intended emotional beat.
inspection: Playable preview plus contact sheet/action-boundary frames; human or vision review for appeal.
stop: Stop when requested effect is reviewed or workflow budget is exhausted.
